name.value: Sun Peaks Grand Hotel & Conference Centre

description.value: Sun Peaks Grand is the only full-service hotel in Sun Peaks Resort, Canada's second-largest ski area, situated ski-in/ski-out just 250 steps from the lifts and surrounded by 84+ km of mountain bike trails. The property offers a dedicated Ski & Bike Valet with complimentary secure overnight bicycle storage off the lower lobby. Guests have access to two on-site restaurants, an outdoor heated pool, a fitness centre, and — in the Residences — fully-equipped kitchens with in-suite laundry.
